common.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this content
common.forbiddenText: If you think this is a mistake, contact the Academic Office.
common.notFoundText: The link does not exist or has changed.

login.subtitle: Sign in with your school email
login.noSignup: Accounts are issued by the Academic Office. Forgot your password? Ask the Academic Office to reset it.

account.rule: 8 to 72 characters, different from the current password.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
account.forcedText: Account {email} is using a temporary password issued by the Academic Office. Set a new password to continue.

dashboard.noDue: Nothing is due in the next 7 days.

admin.step1: Create the semester with its registration period and credit limits
admin.step4: Open course sections, assign instructors, schedule and publish them
admin.step5: Create or import accounts and send each person their temporary password

sections.codeHint: Unique within the semester, e.g. CS301-01
sections.draftHint: New sections start as drafts. Add a schedule before publishing.
sections.findHint: Type at least 2 characters: name, email or student ID
sections.overrideHint: Required. This action is written to the audit log.
sections.unlockText: Finalized course results of this section will be removed; the instructor must lock it again after fixing.

registration.title: Course registration
registration.closed: Outside the registration period: view only
registration.belowMin: You are below the semester's minimum of {min} credits.
registration.empty: No sections are open in this semester.

classes.notEnrolled: You are not in this section. Go to Course registration to register.
classes.provisional: Provisional score {score}/10 ({w}% of the weight graded). No letter grade until the instructor locks the gradebook.
classes.noProvisional: No grades have been released yet.

announcements.title: Title
announcements.posted: Announcement posted; students in the section will be notified.

assignments.title: Assignment / grade column
assignments.deleteText: Delete "{title}". Only possible while it has no submissions and no grades.

modesHint.OVERWRITE: Can be replaced before the deadline while ungraded; only the last version is kept.
modesHint.MULTIPLE: Every attempt is kept; the latest attempt is graded.
modesHint.OFFLINE: E.g. a paper exam: the instructor only enters scores.

visibilityHint.IMMEDIATE: Students see the grade as soon as you save it.
visibilityHint.MANUAL: Grades stay hidden; press Release grades so all students see them at once.

status.gradeHiddenText: Graded, but the instructor has not released the grade yet.

submit.title: Submit work
submit.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, ZIP, RAR, TXT; up to 20 MB
submit.willBeLate: The deadline has passed: a submission now will be marked late.
submit.offline: This assignment is not submitted online; the instructor enters the score directly.
submit.locked: The gradebook is locked; submissions are closed.
submit.graded: Already graded, so no further submissions.
submit.pastDue: The deadline has passed and late submissions are not accepted.
submit.limit: You have used all attempts for this assignment.

regrades.windowHint: Within 7 days after the grade is released; one request per grade.
regrades.hint: Accept: enter the new score (it may stay the same). Reject: a reason is required.

gradebook.hint: Total weight: {total}%. Provisional scores only use graded assignments.

grading.manualHint: Grades for this assignment stay hidden from students until you release them.
grading.publishText: All students will see their grade for this assignment and get a notification. After release, later changes are visible immediately.

lock.title: Conditions for locking
lock.consequence: When locked: missing scores count as 0; course results are finalized and counted in GPA; only the Academic Office can reopen it.
lock.done: Gradebook locked and course results finalized.
lock.lockedText: The gradebook is read-only. Contact the Academic Office to reopen it.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.rules: GPA is weighted by credits; F counts as 0; non-graded and in-progress courses are not counted. Cumulative GPA is recomputed over all courses, not averaged across semesters.

schedule.empty: No class meetings in this semester.

users.hint: There is no public sign-up: all accounts are created by the Academic Office. Users sign in with their email.
users.importHint: Required columns: email, full_name, role (ADMIN/INSTRUCTOR/STUDENT), student_code (required for STUDENT). If any row fails, no account is created.
users.search: Search by name, email, student ID
users.emailHint: Used as the login name; cannot be changed later.
users.resetText: Create a new temporary password for {email}. The user must change it at the next sign-in.
users.tempHint: The system generates a temporary password and shows it only once.
users.tempWarning: Shown only once. Copy it or download the file and send it to each person before closing.

types.REGRADE_RESOLVED: Your regrade request for "{title}" was resolved

audit.hint: The log is append-only: entries cannot be edited or deleted.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check that the API is running on port 5001.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your session has ended, please sign in again.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is locked. Contact the Academic Office.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You need to change your password first.
errors.PASSWORD_POLICY_VIOLATION: The new password does not meet the requirements.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.NOT_SECTION_INSTRUCTOR: Only the section's instructor can do this.
errors.NOT_ENROLLED: You are not in this section.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid, please check them.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already used by another account.
errors.LAST_ADMIN_REQUIRED: You cannot lock or demote yourself, and at least one admin must remain.
errors.ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The role cannot change because the account already has data under its current role.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_ROWS: The file has invalid rows; no account was created.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This status change is not allowed right now.
errors.PREREQUISITE_CYCLE: These prerequisites would form a cycle ({subject_code}).
errors.INVALID_TIME_RANGE: The start time must be before the end time.
errors.SCHEDULE_ROOM_CONFLICT: Room {room_code} is already used by {section_code} at this time.
errors.SCHEDULE_INSTRUCTOR_CONFLICT: The instructor already teaches {section_code} at this time.
errors.ROOM_CAPACITY_TOO_SMALL: Room {room_code} cannot hold a capacity of {required}.
errors.ROOM_IN_USE: Room {room_code} has scheduled classes and cannot be deleted.
errors.SECTION_NOT_OPEN: This section has not been published.
errors.SUBJECT_ALREADY_TAKEN: You already registered for or have a result in {subject_code}.
errors.ALREADY_ENROLLED: You are already in this section.
errors.ASSIGNMENT_WEIGHT_EXCEEDED: Total weight would exceed 100% ({current_total}% now, adding {adding}%).
errors.ASSIGNMENT_HAS_SUBMISSIONS: The assignment already has submissions or grades, so its mode cannot change and it cannot be deleted.
errors.SECTION_LOCKED: The gradebook is locked; changes are not allowed.
errors.SUBMISSION_NOT_ALLOWED: This assignment does not accept online submissions.
errors.SUBMISSION_PAST_DUE: The deadline has passed and late submissions are not accepted.
errors.SUBMISSION_ALREADY_GRADED: Already graded, so no further submissions.
errors.SUBMISSION_EMPTY: Enter a link or choose a file to submit.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {max_mb} MB.
errors.GRADE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Scores must be between 0 and 10 with at most 2 decimals.
errors.LOCK_PRECONDITION_FAILED: The gradebook cannot be locked yet:
errors.UNLOCK_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required to reopen the gradebook.
errors.REGRADE_WINDOW_CLOSED: More than {days} days have passed since the grade was released.
errors.REGRADE_EXISTS: A regrade was already requested for this grade.

reasons.LENGTH: The new password must be 8 to 72 characters long.
reasons.SAME_AS_CURRENT: The new password must differ from the current one.
reasons.INVALID_SEMESTER_RANGE: Check: start date < end date, registration opens < closes, min credits ≤ max credits.
reasons.OFFLINE_HAS_DEADLINE: Offline assignments have no deadline or late policy.
reasons.DEADLINE_REQUIRED: A deadline and a late policy are required.
reasons.MAX_ATTEMPTS_REQUIRED: Multiple-attempt mode needs a maximum number of attempts.
reasons.GRADES_ALREADY_VISIBLE: Grades are already visible, so they cannot be hidden.
reasons.NOT_ACTIVE_INSTRUCTOR: The selected person is not an active instructor.
reasons.NOT_ACTIVE_STUDENT: The selected person is not an active student.
reasons.BELOW_ENROLLED: Capacity cannot be lower than the number of enrolled students ({enrolled}).
reasons.INVALID_URL: The link must start with http:// or https://.
reasons.NO_SCHEDULE: The section has no schedule yet, so it cannot be published.
reasons.NOT_MANUAL: Grades for this assignment are already shown immediately.
